description: The RoleSpec archetype's YAML-extracted yield record (record_validation, FR-020): the values of `yield_pattern.match`, keyed by the match key names verbatim. An evaluation row is one tab-joined string `ID<TAB>Rule<TAB>Evidence source<TAB>Trigger<TAB>Method<TAB>Query or rubric<TAB>Evaluator<TAB>Comparator<TAB>Value<TAB>Unit<TAB>Cadence`. It holds the method-conditional rules the `assert` facet cannot express: a `deterministic` row is checked by the `evaluator` over a query reference, a `judgement` row is judged by the `director` or `team-retro` over a versioned rubric reference and never at cadence `tick`. The vocabularies themselves (method, cadence, evidence source) are the `assert` facet's. It is the module's own schema for the extracted record and is not the emitted record schema: `RoleSpec.json` (camelCase keys, the mapped record) is projected from TypeSpec.
